from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceEntry(BaseModel):
    """A specific 'Beginning Cash and Cash Equivalents' value found within a single company's financial statements."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reported in the document")
    statement_line_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label used for the balance in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the balance as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this balance")
    statement_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial statement containing this figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_entries: list[CashBalanceEntry]
